title: The ROCK1 PHC1 domain mediates recruitment to Rho activity zones and contractility signaling.
authors: Gierse, Carolin; Vetter, Ingrid R; Schweizer, Donna; Dehmelt, Leif
one_liner_zh: 该文研究ROCK1蛋白PHC1结构域介导的Rho信号区招募与收缩信号传导，虽以细胞生物学功能为主，但使用AlphaFold指导突变解析结构域功能，涉及蛋白质结构预测工具的应用，对蛋白结构-功能关系研究有参考价值。
abstract: The spatiotemporal regulation of cell contraction is crucial for numerous biological processes. In particular, local, subcellular contraction pulses in the cell cortex contribute to mechanotransduction and tissue rearrangements during embryonic development. We previously identified a signaling network that generates mechanosensitive contraction pulses in adherent mammalian cells through positive and negative feedback regulation of the small GTPase RhoA. Here, we show that ROCK1 is rapidly recruited to cortical pulsatile Rho activity zones and that efficient recruitment is synergistically mediated by the canonical Rho-binding domain and the C-terminal PHC1 domain. Surprisingly, the isolated ROCK1 PHC1 domain by itself is already sufficient for dynamic recruitment to active Rho signaling zones in cells, and AlphaFold-guided mutagenesis identifies conserved PHC1 residues that are required for this recruitment. Functional investigations show that the PHC1 domain plays an important role in transduction of Rho activity to myosin activation. Together, our data revise models of ROCK1 regulation by identifying a C-terminal PHC1 domain-dependent mechanism that contributes to ROCK1 recruitment and signal transduction during cell contraction pulses.
abstract_zh: 细胞收缩的时空调控对众多生物学过程至关重要。特别是，细胞皮层中的局部亚细胞收缩脉冲在胚胎发育过程中促进机械传导和组织重排。我们先前识别出一个信号网络，通过小GTP酶RhoA的正负反馈调控，在贴壁哺乳动物细胞中产生机械敏感的收缩脉冲。在此，我们展示ROCK1被迅速招募至皮层脉冲性Rho活性区域，且其高效招募由经典Rho结合域和C端PHC1域协同介导。令人惊讶的是，分离的ROCK1 PHC1域本身已足以在细胞中动态招募至活性Rho信号区域，而AlphaFold引导的突变分析识别出对此招募所需的保守PHC1残基。功能研究表明，PHC1域在将Rho活性转导至肌球蛋白激活中发挥重要作用。综合来看，我们的数据通过识别一个依赖C端PHC1域的机制，修正了ROCK1调控模型，该机制在细胞收缩脉冲期间促进ROCK1招募和信号转导。
